Tutor-For-All is a student-led nonprofit that gives children from low-income families free one-on-one math and reading tutoring. We are looking for high school and college students to volunteer as online tutors for children in kindergarten through 5th grade.

This is a 100% remote volunteer role. You can apply from anywhere in the world. Sessions are about an hour a week over Google Meet, at times you choose in your own time zone. You do not need to speak English: we match you with children who speak your language.

You earn one verified volunteer hour per session. Requirements: currently enrolled in high school or college, a 3.5 GPA or the same level in your country's grading system, a 90 or above in the subject you tutor, reliable internet and a computer or tablet, and one to two hours a week. No teaching experience is needed. We train you.

fc17bffd6f.en: Your child’s safety comes first. Here is exactly what we do before a tutor meets a child, during every session, and if anything ever goes wrong.

fc228ebd6a.en: We are happy to answer them before you sign up.

fc3bd6faf2.en: Tutor-For-All is for children in kindergarten through 5th grade from low-income households, in any country. The form asks a few confidential questions so our limited spots go to the families who need them most. Not sure if you qualify? Apply anyway.

fc429fe793.en: You do not write lesson plans. Every session follows the same simple plan. Five minutes of preparation is enough.

fc5e551ed4.en: Your child and the tutor read together on a shared screen. They take turns reading aloud, stop to talk about new words, and answer questions about the story. Younger children practice letter sounds and short words. Older children work on longer books and on explaining what they read.
